question: Which organic compound has a pleasant almond aroma that is commonly used to impart almond flavour to chocolate and baked goods?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Benzaldehyde.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Benzaldehyde is an organic compound with a pleasant almond aroma that is commonly used to impart almond flavor to chocolate and baked goods.**
 
• It is a** colorless liquid with a characteristic almond-like odor.**
 
• ** Benzaldehyde is also used as a flavoring agent in** **foods and beverages, as well as in perfumes and cosmetics.**
 
• It is naturally occurring in many fruits and essential oils, including almonds, cherries, apricots, and cinnamon.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Manzanita is not a commonly used organic compound in the food industry. It is a type of apple that is often used in the production of cider.
 
• Ethyl maltol is a synthetic flavoring agent that is commonly used in the food industry to impart a sweet, caramel-like flavor to foods and beverages. It is not used to impart an almond flavor.
 
• Isoamyl acetate is a naturally occurring compound found in many fruits, including bananas, apples, and strawberries. It is commonly used as a flavoring agent in foods and beverages, but it does not impart an almond flavor.
